Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) se tosha le kar ghar mein chale jate aur kayi kayi ratain wahin ibadat mein guzara karte, phir aate aur tosha le kar chale jate, yahan tak ke ek martaba achanak wahin shuru shuru mein wahi aayi, farishta Aap (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha "Iqra" yani parhiye. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain, main ne kaha main parhna nahin janta. Farishtay ne mujhe dobara dabocha yahan tak ke mujhe takleef hui, phir chhor diya aur farmaya "parho", main ne phir yahi kaha ke main parhne wala nahin, us ne mujhe teesri martaba pakar kar dabaya aur takleef pohanchayi, phir chhor diya aur "Iqra bismi rabbikallazi khalaq" se "ma lam ya'lam" tak parha. Aap (ﷺ) in ayaton ko liye hue kanpte hue Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya mujhe kapra orha do, chunancha kapra orha diya yahan tak ke dar-o-khauf jata raha to Aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Khadija (R.A) se sara waqia bayan kiya aur farmaya mujhe apni jaan jane ka khauf hai. Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ne kaha huzoor Aap khush hojaiye, Allah ki qasam Allah Ta'ala Aap ko hargiz ruswa na karega, Aap sila-e-rahmi karte hain, sachi batain karte hain, dusron ka bojh khud uthate hain, mehman nawazi karte hain aur haq par dusron ki madad karte hain. Phir Hazrat Khadija (R.A) Aap (ﷺ) ko le kar apne chacha zaad bhai Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abdul Uzza bin Qusai ke paas aayin, jahiliyat ke zamane mein yeh Nasrani hogaye thay, Arabi kitab likhte thay aur Ibrani mein Injeel likhte thay, bohat bari umar ke intehahi burhay thay, aankhain ja chuki thin. Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ne un se kaha ke apne bhatijay ka waqia suniye, Waraqa ne poocha bhatijay! Aap ne kya dekha? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne sara waqia keh sunaya. Waraqa ne suntay hi kaha ke yahi woh raaz daan farishta hai jo Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke paas bhi Allah ka bheja hua aaya karta tha, kaash ke main us waqt jawan hota, kaash ke main us waqt zinda hota jabke Aap ko Aap ki qoum nikal degi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ta'ajjub se sawal kiya ke kya woh mujhe nikal denge? Waraqa ne kaha haan, ek Aap kya jitne bhi log Aap ki tarah nabuwat se sarfaraz ho kar aaye un sab se dushmaniyan ki gayin. Agar woh waqt meri zindagi mein aagaya to main Aap ki poori poori madad karunga, lekin is waqia ke baad Waraqa bohat kam zinda rahe. Idhar wahi bhi ruk gayi aur us ke rukne ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bara qalaq tha, kayi martaba Aap (ﷺ) ne pahar ki choti par se apne tayein gira dena chaha lekin har waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aajate aur farma dete ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) Aap Allah Ta'ala ke sachay Rasool hain. Is se Aap (ﷺ) ka qalaq aur ranj-o-gham jata rehta aur dil mein qadray itminan paida hojata aur aaram se ghar wapas aajate (Musnad Ahmad). Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim mein bhi barwayat Zuhri marwi hai, is ki sanad mein, is ke matan mein, is ke ma'ani mein jo kuch bayan karna chahiye tha woh hum ne apni Sharh-e-Bukhari mein pooray tor par bayan kar diya hai.

Agar jee chaha wahin dekh liya jaye, walhamdulillah. Pas Quran-e-Kareem ki ba-aitbar-e-nuzool ke sab se pehli ayatein yehi hain, yehi pehli nemat hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon par in'aam ki aur yehi woh pehli rahmat hai jo us Arham-ur-Rahimeen ne apne raham-o-karam se hamein di. Is mein tanbeeh hai insaan ki awwal paidaish par ke woh ek jame hue khoon ki shakal mein tha, Allah Ta'ala ne us par yeh ehsaan kiya, use achi surat mein paida kiya, phir ilm jaisi apni khaas nemat use marhamat farmayi aur woh sikhaya jise woh nahin jaanta tha. Ilm hi ki barkat thi ke kul insaanon ke baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) farishton mein bhi mumtaz nazar aaye. Ilm kabhi to zehan mein hi hota hai aur kabhi zaban par hota hai aur kabhi kitabi surat mein likha hua hota hai. Pas ilm ki teen qismein huin: zehni, lafzi aur rasmi. Aur rasmi ilm zehni aur lafzi ko mustalzim hai lekin woh dono use mustalzim nahin. Isi liye farmaya ke parh! Tera Rab to bade ikram wala hai, jis ne qalam ke zariye ilm sikhaya aur aadmi ko jo woh nahin jaanta tha maloom kara diya. Ek asar mein warid hai ke ilm ko likh liya karo, aur isi asar mein hai ke jo shakhs apne ilm par amal kare use Allah Ta'ala us ilm ka bhi waris kar deta hai jise woh nahin jaanta tha.

Waraqa ne suntay hi kaha ke yahi woh raaz daan farishta hai jo Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke paas bhi Allah ka bheja hua aaya karta tha, kaash ke main us waqt jawan hota, kaash ke main us waqt zinda hota jabke Aap ko Aap ki qoum nikal degi. Agar woh waqt meri zindagi mein aagaya to main Aap ki poori poori madad karunga, lekin is waqia ke baad Waraqa bohat kam zinda rahe. Agar jee chaha wahin dekh liya jaye, walhamdulillah. Pas Quran-e-Kareem ki ba-aitbar-e-nuzool ke sab se pehli ayatein yehi hain, yehi pehli nemat hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon par in'aam ki aur yehi woh pehli rahmat hai jo us Arham-ur-Rahimeen ne apne raham-o-karam se hamein di. Is mein tanbeeh hai insaan ki awwal paidaish par ke woh ek jame hue khoon ki shakal mein tha, Allah Ta'ala ne us par yeh ehsaan kiya, use achi surat mein paida kiya, phir ilm jaisi apni khaas nemat use marhamat farmayi aur woh sikhaya jise woh nahin jaanta tha. Ilm hi ki barkat thi ke kul insaanon ke baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) farishton mein bhi mumtaz nazar aaye. Ilm kabhi to zehan mein hi hota hai aur kabhi zaban par hota hai aur kabhi kitabi surat mein likha hua hota hai. Pas ilm ki teen qismein huin: zehni, lafzi aur rasmi. Aur rasmi ilm zehni aur lafzi ko mustalzim hai lekin woh dono use mustalzim nahin. Isi liye farmaya ke parh! Tera Rab to bade ikram wala hai, jis ne qalam ke zariye ilm sikhaya aur aadmi ko jo woh nahin jaanta tha maloom kara diya. Ek asar mein warid hai ke ilm ko likh liya karo, aur isi asar mein hai ke jo shakhs apne ilm par amal kare use Allah Ta'ala us ilm ka bhi waris kar deta hai jise woh nahin jaanta tha.

Talib-e-ilm aur talib-e-dunya: Farmata hai ke insaan ke paas jahan do paise hue zara farigh-ul-baal hua ke uske dil mein kibr-o-ghuroor, ujb-o-khud pasandi aayi. Use darte rehna chahiye aur khayal rakhna chahiye ke use ek din Allah ki taraf lautna hai, wahan jahan aur hisab honge. Maal ki babat bhi sawal hoga ke laya kahan se, kharch kahan kiya? Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain do lalchi aise hain jin ka pait hi nahin bharta, ek talib-e-ilm aur dusra talib-e-dunya. In dono mein bada farq hai. Ilm ka talib toh Allah ki razamandi ke hasil karne mein badhta rehta hai aur dunya ka lalchi sarkashi aur khud pasandi mein badhta rehta hai. Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi jis mein dunya daron ka zikr hai, phir talib-e-ilmon ki fazeelat ke bayan ki yeh aayat tilawat ki: "Innama yakhshallaha min ibadihil ulama" (35:28). Yeh hadees marfoo'an yani Nabi ﷺ ke farman se bhi marwi hai ke do lalchi hain jo shikam par nahin hote, talib-e-ilm aur talib-e-dunya. Is ke baad ki aayat Abu Jahl maloon ke bare mein nazil hui hain ke yeh An-Hazrat ﷺ ko Baitullah mein namaz padhne se rokta tha. Pas pehle toh ise behtareen tareeqa samjha gaya ke jinhein tu rokta hai yahi agar seedhi raah par hon, inhi ki baatein taqwe ki taraf bulati hon, phir toh inhein par tashaddud kare aur Khana-e-Allah se roke toh teri badqismati ki inteha hai ya nahin? Kya yeh rokne wala jo na sirf khud haq ki rahnumai se mehroom hai balkay raah-e-haq se rokne ke darpay hai, itna bhi nahin jaanta ke Allah Ta'ala use dekh raha hai, us ka kalam sun raha hai aur us ke kalam aur kaam par use saza de ga. Is tarah samjha chukne ke baad ab Allah dara raha hai ke agar us ne mukhalifat, sarkashi aur eza-dahi na chhod di toh hum bhi us ki peshani ke baal pakad kar ghaseetenge jo aqwal mein jhoota aur af'aal mein badkar hai. Yeh apne madadgaron, ham-nasheenon, qarabat-daron aur kunba qabeelay walon ko bula le. Dekhein toh kaun us ki mudafiat kar sakta hai. Hum bhi apne azab ke farishton ko bula lete hain, phir har ek ko khul jaye ga ke kaun jeeta aur kaun haara? Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad ﷺ ko Kaaba mein namaz padhte hue dekhunga toh gardan se daboochunga. Huzoor ﷺ ko bhi khabar pahunchi toh aap ne farmaya ke agar yeh aisa kare ga toh Allah ke farishte pakad lenge. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas Baitullah mein namaz padh rahe the ke yeh maloon aaya aur kehne laga ke main ne tujhe mana kar diya phir bhi tu baaz nahin aaya, agar ab main ne tujhe Kaabay mein namaz padhte hue dekha toh sakht saza dunga waghera. Nabi ﷺ ne sakhti se jawab diya, us ki baat ko thukra diya aur achi tarah daant diya. Is par woh kehne laga ke tu mujhe daantta hai? Allah ki qasam meri ek aawaz par yeh saari wadi aadmiyon se bhar jaye gi. Is par yeh aayat utri ke acha toh apne hamiyon ko bula, hum bhi apne farishton ko bula lete hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha agar main Rasoolullah ﷺ ko Baitullah mein namaz parhte hue dekh lunga toh uski gardan tor doonga. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya agar woh aisa karta toh isi waqt logon ke dekhte hue azab ke farishtay usay pakar lete aur isi tarah jabke Yahudiyon se Quran ne kaha tha ke agar tum sachay ho toh maut mango, agar woh isay qabool kar lete aur maut talab karte toh saray ke saray mar jatay aur Jahannam mein apni jagah dekh lete aur jin Nasraniyon ko mubahila ki dawat di gayi thi agar yeh mubahila ke liye nikalte toh laut kar na apna maal patay na apne baal bachon ko patay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha agar main Aap ﷺ ko Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas namaz parhta hua dekh loonga toh jaan se maar daaloonga, is par yeh surat utri. Huzoor ﷺ tashreef le gaye, Abu Jahl majood tha aur Aap ﷺ ne wahin namaz ada ki toh logon ne us badbakht se kaha ke kyun baitha raha? Usne kaha kya bataoon kaun mere aur unke darmiyan hail ho gaye. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain agar zara bhi hilta julta toh logon ke dekhte hue farishtay usay halak kar daalte. Ibn-e-Jarir ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Abu Jahl ne poocha ke kya Muhammad ﷺ tumhare samne sajda karte hain? Logon ne kaha haan, toh kehne laga ke Allah ki qasam agar mere samne usne yeh kiya toh uski gardan rond doonga aur uske munh ko mitti mein mila doonga. Idhar usne yeh kaha, udhar Rasoolullah ﷺ wa barak alaihi ne namaz shuru ki, jab Aap ﷺ sajday mein gaye toh yeh aagay barha lekin sath hi apne hath se apne aap ko bachata hua pichlay pairon nihayat bad-hawasi se peechay hata. Logon ne kaha kya hua hai? Kehne laga ke mere aur Huzoor ﷺ ke darmiyan aag ki khandaq hai aur ghabrahat ki khaufnak cheezein hain aur farishton ke par hain waghera. Is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar yeh zara qareeb aa jata toh farishtay iska ek ek uzw alag alag kar dete. Pas yeh aayatein "Kalla Innal Insana Layatgha" se aakhir-e-surat tak nazil huin. Allah hi ko ilm hai ke yeh kalam Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki hadith mein hai ya nahin? Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Muslim, Nasai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi hai. Phir farmaya ke ae Nabi ﷺ! Tum is mardood ki baat na manna, ibadat par mudawamat karna aur bakasrat ibadat karte rehna aur jahan jee chahay namaz parhte rehna aur iski mutlaq parwah na karna. Allah Ta'ala khud tera hafiz-o-nasir hai. Woh tujhe dushmanon se mehfooz rakhega, tu sajday mein aur qurb-e-Allah ki talab mein mashghool reh. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain sajday ki halat mein banda apne Rab Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se bohat hi qareeb hota hai, pas tum bakasrat sajdon mein duayein karte raho. Pehle yeh hadith bhi guzar chuki hai ke Huzoor ﷺ Surah Idhas-Sama-un-Shaqqat mein aur is surat mein sajda kiya karte thay. Allah Ta'ala ki taufeeq se Surah Iqra ki tafseer khatam hui. Allah ka shukr-o-ehsan hai.

Idhar usne yeh kaha, udhar Rasoolullah ﷺ wa barak alaihi ne namaz shuru ki, jab Aap ﷺ sajday mein gaye toh yeh aagay barha lekin sath hi apne hath se apne aap ko bachata hua pichlay pairon nihayat bad-hawasi se peechay hata. Logon ne kaha kya hua hai? Kehne laga ke mere aur Huzoor ﷺ ke darmiyan aag ki khandaq hai aur ghabrahat ki khaufnak cheezein hain aur farishton ke par hain waghera. Is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar yeh zara qareeb aa jata toh farishtay iska ek ek uzw alag alag kar dete. Pas yeh aayatein "Kalla Innal Insana Layatgha" se aakhir-e-surat tak nazil huin. Allah hi ko ilm hai ke yeh kalam Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki hadith mein hai ya nahin? Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Muslim, Nasai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi hai. Phir farmaya ke ae Nabi ﷺ! Tum is mardood ki baat na manna, ibadat par mudawamat karna aur bakasrat ibadat karte rehna aur jahan jee chahay namaz parhte rehna aur iski mutlaq parwah na karna. Allah Ta'ala khud tera hafiz-o-nasir hai. Woh tujhe dushmanon se mehfooz rakhega, tu sajday mein aur qurb-e-Allah ki talab mein mashghool reh. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain sajday ki halat mein banda apne Rab Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se bohat hi qareeb hota hai, pas tum bakasrat sajdon mein duayein karte raho. Pehle yeh hadith bhi guzar chuki hai ke Huzoor ﷺ Surah Idhas-Sama-un-Shaqqat mein aur is surat mein sajda kiya karte thay. Allah Ta'ala ki taufeeq se Surah Iqra ki tafseer khatam hui. Allah ka shukr-o-ehsan hai.

Talib-e-ilm aur talib-e-dunya: Farmata hai ke insaan ke paas jahan do paise hue zara farigh-ul-baal hua ke uske dil mein kibr-o-ghuroor, ujb-o-khud pasandi aayi. Use darte rehna chahiye aur khayal rakhna chahiye ke use ek din Allah ki taraf lautna hai, wahan jahan aur hisab honge. Maal ki babat bhi sawal hoga ke laya kahan se, kharch kahan kiya? Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain do lalchi aise hain jin ka pait hi nahin bharta, ek talib-e-ilm aur dusra talib-e-dunya. In dono mein bada farq hai. Ilm ka talib toh Allah ki razamandi ke hasil karne mein badhta rehta hai aur dunya ka lalchi sarkashi aur khud pasandi mein badhta rehta hai. Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi jis mein dunya daron ka zikr hai, phir talib-e-ilmon ki fazeelat ke bayan ki yeh aayat tilawat ki: "Innama yakhshallaha min ibadihil ulama" (35:28). Yeh hadees marfoo'an yani Nabi ﷺ ke farman se bhi marwi hai ke do lalchi hain jo shikam par nahin hote, talib-e-ilm aur talib-e-dunya. Is ke baad ki aayat Abu Jahl maloon ke bare mein nazil hui hain ke yeh An-Hazrat ﷺ ko Baitullah mein namaz padhne se rokta tha. Pas pehle toh ise behtareen tareeqa samjha gaya ke jinhein tu rokta hai yahi agar seedhi raah par hon, inhi ki baatein taqwe ki taraf bulati hon, phir toh inhein par tashaddud kare aur Khana-e-Allah se roke toh teri badqismati ki inteha hai ya nahin? Kya yeh rokne wala jo na sirf khud haq ki rahnumai se mehroom hai balkay raah-e-haq se rokne ke darpay hai, itna bhi nahin jaanta ke Allah Ta'ala use dekh raha hai, us ka kalam sun raha hai aur us ke kalam aur kaam par use saza de ga. Is tarah samjha chukne ke baad ab Allah dara raha hai ke agar us ne mukhalifat, sarkashi aur eza-dahi na chhod di toh hum bhi us ki peshani ke baal pakad kar ghaseetenge jo aqwal mein jhoota aur af'aal mein badkar hai. Yeh apne madadgaron, ham-nasheenon, qarabat-daron aur kunba qabeelay walon ko bula le. Dekhein toh kaun us ki mudafiat kar sakta hai. Hum bhi apne azab ke farishton ko bula lete hain, phir har ek ko khul jaye ga ke kaun jeeta aur kaun haara? Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad ﷺ ko Kaaba mein namaz padhte hue dekhunga toh gardan se daboochunga. Huzoor ﷺ ko bhi khabar pahunchi toh aap ne farmaya ke agar yeh aisa kare ga toh Allah ke farishte pakad lenge. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas Baitullah mein namaz padh rahe the ke yeh maloon aaya aur kehne laga ke main ne tujhe mana kar diya phir bhi tu baaz nahin aaya, agar ab main ne tujhe Kaabay mein namaz padhte hue dekha toh sakht saza dunga waghera. Nabi ﷺ ne sakhti se jawab diya, us ki baat ko thukra diya aur achi tarah daant diya. Is par woh kehne laga ke tu mujhe daantta hai? Allah ki qasam meri ek aawaz par yeh saari wadi aadmiyon se bhar jaye gi. Is par yeh aayat utri ke acha toh apne hamiyon ko bula, hum bhi apne farishton ko bula lete hain.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A farmate hain agar woh apne walon ko pukarta toh isi waqt azab ke farishtay usay lapak lete (mulahiza ho Tirmidhi waghera). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha agar main Rasoolullah ﷺ ko Baitullah mein namaz parhte hue dekh lunga toh uski gardan tor doonga. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya agar woh aisa karta toh isi waqt logon ke dekhte hue azab ke farishtay usay pakar lete aur isi tarah jabke Yahudiyon se Quran ne kaha tha ke agar tum sachay ho toh maut mango, agar woh isay qabool kar lete aur maut talab karte toh saray ke saray mar jatay aur Jahannam mein apni jagah dekh lete aur jin Nasraniyon ko mubahila ki dawat di gayi thi agar yeh mubahila ke liye nikalte toh laut kar na apna maal patay na apne baal bachon ko patay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Abu Jahl ne kaha agar main Aap ﷺ ko Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas namaz parhta hua dekh loonga toh jaan se maar daaloonga, is par yeh surat utri.
